_about: M3-CRE-611 post-import rules for the ambient wildlife (game/core/import/wildlife_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules): assets/wildlife/<id>/*.glb, unskinned meshes drawn through MultiMesh by WildlifeLayer (docs/kb/art/wildlife.md). Each glTF material slot maps to <asset dir>/materials/<slot>.tres (assets_src/wildlife/common/write_materials.py). No generated LODs (a MultiMesh picks one LOD for its whole flock, and the meshes are already a few hundred to a thousand triangles), no authored chains and no collision (wildlife never blocks the player).
